fato_historico: 1590: Tokugawa Ieyasu enters Edo Castle. (Traditional Japanese date: August 1, 1590)
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you are entering a new stronghold of your life, much like a visionary ruler claiming a magnificent future. It is a good time to build your foundations with confidence. You may find that your personal power radiates outward today, allowing you to establish lasting influence and manifest your grandest creative visions with elegance and grace.
frase_do_dia: Your inner light is the strongest fortress you will ever build.
significado_numero: Represents infinite potential, abundance, and the mastery of your own fate.
